query:
SELECT u.id,
                  u.name,
                  u.email,
                  u.role::text AS "role!",
                  COALESCE(
                      array_agg(t.name ORDER BY t.name) FILTER (WHERE t.name IS NOT NULL),
                      ARRAY[]::text[]
                  ) AS "teams!"
           FROM users u
           LEFT JOIN user_teams ut ON ut.user_id = u.id
           LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = ut.team_id
           GROUP BY u.id, u.name, u.email, u.role
           ORDER BY u.name
